title: docs(agents): write down the shape a --self-test must have to be capable of failing
body:
Fixes #15410

Clause-②: no
Reason: this adds PROSE to `AGENTS.md`. No gate rule, threshold, ledger, exemption list or population is touched, and no acceptance set is widened — nothing that used to be refused is now admitted.

⛔ **GOVERNED SURFACE — this PR stays draft.** `AGENTS.md` is the rules layer. Review is requested from both authorized approvers (`GOVERNED_APPROVERS` = os-zhuang, hotlong). The dispatching seat will not arm auto-merge, will not enqueue and will not merge it. It lands by human approval or not at all.

## 🛑 It is RED on purpose, and the red is the decision this PR asks for

`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` fails, with exactly one finding:

```
✗ check-skill-line-ratchet: AGENTS.md is 1116 lines; the ratchet ceiling is 1075.
  ... Raising a ceiling requires a maintainer ruling quoted in the PR.
```

`AGENTS.md` stood at **1075 lines against a ceiling of 1075 — headroom 0** before this change. This section is **+41 lines**, so the ask is a ceiling raise **1075 → 1116**.

What was deliberately NOT done, and why each exit is closed:

| exit the ratchet offers | why not taken |
|:--|:--|
| lower the ceiling | only available to a PR that SHRINKS the file |
| raise it in this PR | requires a maintainer ruling quoted in the body. There is none yet — so `CEILINGS` in `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` is **untouched**, and raising a budget is not the executing seat's to take |
| pay by deleting | the dispatch forbids deleting other rule lines to make room, and a re-wrap is not legal currency here — only deleted CONTENT pays |
| pay by cross-file move | would require editing a second governed file in this PR, which the dispatch forbids |

⇒ The line count is reported measured and red rather than manufactured green. **One ruling quoted in this body plus the one-line `CEILINGS` edit turns it green; nothing else in the diff changes.**

## What the section says

The card's measurement: `--self-test` is mandatory, its EXISTENCE is mechanically enforced by `scripts/check-self-test-wired.mjs`, and its SHAPE is written down nowhere — so 116 scripts re-derived it into 168 different assertion helpers. The cost is not the duplication; it is the dispersion in rigour. With `failures.length === 0` as the only success condition, **"every case passed" and "no case ran" print the same line** — and for a gate whose defect class is its own matching rule, the self-test is the only instrument there is.

The new section states that shape as a judgeable contract, not as advice:

1. **Two holes, named as orthogonal** — no assertion floor, and no verdict handshake. A self-test clean on one is still defeated by the other.
2. **The floor pins NAMES, not a total** — a frozen roster of battery name → minimum case count; fail when a declared battery under-registers, when a registered case names no declared battery, or when the roster itself falls below a pinned battery count. ⛔ A printed case count is evidence, not proof, and one pinned TOTAL rots when a sibling battery grows.
3. **The handshake makes the dispatch read something the verdict SET** — with the two accident shapes named as ⛔ non-handshakes: `process.exit(selfTest())` is `process.exit(undefined)` → exit 0, and `selfTest() === 0` exits 1 having printed ZERO BYTES.
4. **Copy a landed one, ⛔ never import one** — `scripts/check-agent-model-declared.mjs` carries all three parts, and most of `scripts/` already spells it this way. Per the card, a shared assertion library is explicitly NOT the direction: every self-test must keep running standalone, and one import edge would be a single point of failure for every instrument at once.
5. **The instrument is a measurement, not a per-PR gate** — `scripts/measure-self-test-floor.mjs`, with `--probe --only PATH` as the way to read your own script, and the three verdicts spelled out (DEFEATED / HELD / ACCIDENT).

## Provenance of the one number it cites

The section quotes the first segment's landed sizing read — `docs/audits/2026-09-self-test-shape-census.md`, 179 members, **165 HELD / 4 DEFEATED / 1 ACCIDENT / 9 NOT MEASURED** — and carries it **as a reading of that tree on 2026-09-05**, not as a standing claim about today's tree. ⛔ No number was re-derived for this PR, and the card's original `20 of 170` grep estimate is not repeated anywhere: it was superseded by that behavioural measurement.

Direction 2 (a second assertion inside `check-self-test-wired.mjs`) is **not** in this PR — ruling `5548566694` answered Q1 "B, then C", refusing option A and deferring option D until the residue baseline is empty. This is the C half.

## Gates

Derived with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` against the real diff — 14 commands, all run, exit codes captured before any pipe:

- **13 green**, including `check:pm-governed-prose`, `check:pm-governed-merges`, `check:pm-skill-id-lint`, `check:nul-bytes`, `check:agent-test-spelling`, `check:watch-hint-literal`, `check:required-contexts`.
- **1 red**: `check:pm-skill-ratchet` — the ceiling, above. This is the only finding in the whole run.

The 120-byte max-line-length rule was checked over the inserted range independently: 0 lines exceed it. `skip-changeset`: no published package ships `AGENTS.md` — measured over every non-private `files[]` in `packages/`, `services/` and `apps/`, zero hits.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么** — 给 `AGENTS.md` 加一节(41 行),把「怎么写一个 `--self-test`」从口口相传变成可判定的契约:自检必须能在「一个用例都没跑」时变红,并写明两种做法(钉住 battery 名册 + 每个 battery 的最小用例数;以及 dispatch 必须读一个由 verdict 设置的标志)。同时点名两种看起来像检查、实际什么都没检查的写法。没有删任何既有规则行。

**为什么改** — 仓库强制要求 `--self-test`,并且用门禁机械保证「它存在、CI 会跑它」,但**怎么写从来没写下来**。结果是 116 个脚本各自发明,造出 168 个不同的断言助手。真正的代价不是重复,是严谨度参差:`failures.length === 0` 作唯一成功条件时,「每个用例都过了」和「一个用例都没跑」打印出来一模一样。而对于「规则本身就是缺陷类」的门禁,自检是唯一的仪器 —— 自检空转,等于同一个失效往上挪了一层。

**风险与代价(含回滚)** — 风险极低:纯散文,不动任何门禁逻辑、不动任何包。**唯一的代价是行数预算**:`AGENTS.md` 本来就顶在天花板上(1075/1075,余量 0),这 41 行需要一次天花板上调 1075 → 1116。执行席**没有**自己改 `CEILINGS`,也**没有**删别的规则行来筹这 41 行 —— 两者都不是执行席能自取的。回滚就是 revert 这一个 commit,树立刻回到 1075 行,门禁全绿;不留任何残留。

**席位意见** — (留空,待维护者填写)

**你要做的** — 一个动作:**裁定这 41 行值不值这次天花板上调**。值 ⇒ 在本 PR 正文里留一句裁决原话,并把 `scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs` 里的 `['AGENTS.md', 1075]` 改成 `1116`(一行),门禁即绿,再人工批准合并;不值 ⇒ 说一个目标行数,由执行席压缩后重报实测行数。⛔ 无论哪种,本 PR 都不会由 agent 合并。
